content.short: NFTX lets users deposit NFTs into vaults to mint ERC-20 tokens that represent claims on the vault assets.
content.description: Founded in 2020, NFTX is a marketplace that enables users to create liquid markets for illiquid NFTs. Participants deposit their NFTs into vaults and mint ERC-20 tokens (vTokens) that represent claims on the vault's assets, which can then be redeemed to obtain the underlying NFTs. By converting non-fungible holdings into tradeable tokens, this approach unlocks liquidity, lets collectors earn yield on their NFT investments, and helps improve distribution and price discovery for NFT projects.
